title: Matching and Recommendation
description: How systems decide who gets connected to whom — stable matching and marketplace dispatch on one side, retrieval-and-ranking recommenders on the other. Half theory, half production practice.
objectives: Explain why scarcity, not algorithm choice, separates a matching problem from a recommendation problem
Describe deferred acceptance and say what makes a matching stable
Read a recommender as a funnel: retrieval, filtering, ranking, re-ranking
Name the production failure modes each kind of system is prone to
